review.note: Places were selected by Waypoint from official tourism boards' published destinations. Each entry has not yet been checked against its page by a person. Opening hours, prices and closures change: check the source before you go. Descriptions: the first sentence of each place's Wikipedia article where descBy is wikipedia (the article link is in ground); otherwise Waypoint's own text (descBy: curated).

desc.en: Central lake with the Turtle Tower and a temple on an islet.
desc.es: Lago central con la Torre de la Tortuga y un templo en un islote.

desc.en: Street-food stalls and craft streets.
desc.es: Puestos de comida callejera y calles de artesanía.

desc.en: National history museum; check opening days.
desc.es: Museo nacional de historia; revisa los días de apertura.

desc.en: Limestone karsts on cruises; book a reputable boat.
desc.es: Karst de piedra caliza en cruceros; elige un barco confiable.

desc.en: Central covered market.
desc.es: Mercado central techado.

desc.en: Lantern-lit town with preserved trading houses.
desc.es: Ciudad de faroles con casas de comercio conservadas.

desc.en: A landmark tower of 143 concrete pillars rising toward the sea, built in 2025 on the Thùy Vân (Back Beach) seafront plaza.
desc.es: Torre emblemática de 143 pilares de hormigón que se elevan hacia el mar, construida en 2025 en la plaza frente a Thùy Vân (Bãi Sau).

desc.en: A 32 m statue of Christ with 18.3 m outstretched arms atop Núi Nhỏ, completed in 1994, with a 133-step staircase inside.
desc.es: Estatua de Cristo de 32 m con brazos extendidos de 18,3 m en lo alto del Núi Nhỏ, terminada en 1994, con una escalera interior de 133 peldaños.

image.file: Statue of Jesus in Vung Tau.jpg
image.author: Chris Phan from Eugene, Oregon, United States

desc.en: An 18 m white cylindrical lighthouse on Núi Nhỏ, first built by the French in 1862 and rebuilt in 1913, among the oldest in Vietnam and Southeast Asia.
desc.es: Faro cilíndrico blanco de 18 m en el Núi Nhỏ, construido por los franceses en 1862 y reconstruido en 1913, uno de los más antiguos de Vietnam y el Sudeste Asiático.

desc.en: A late-19th-century European-style villa (Villa Blanche) on the slope of Núi Lớn, once a retreat for Indochina's governors-general and a national heritage site since 1992.
desc.es: Villa de estilo europeo de finales del siglo XIX (Villa Blanche) en la ladera del Núi Lớn, antigua residencia de descanso de gobernadores de Indochina y patrimonio nacional desde 1992.

desc.en: Bãi Sau, also called Bãi Thùy Vân, is the main sandy beach on the eastern side of the Vung Tau peninsula.
desc.es: Bãi Sau, también llamada Bãi Thùy Vân, es la principal playa de arena en el lado este de la península de Vung Tau.

image.file: Ảnh đẹp Vũng Tàu - Biển bãi sau - Gần Hòn Bà.jpg
image.author: Willyvu

desc.en: Bãi Trước, also known as Bãi Tầm Dương, is the beach on the western, bay-facing side of Vung Tau city.
desc.es: Bãi Trước, también conocida como Bãi Tầm Dương, es la playa del lado oeste de la ciudad de Vung Tau, frente a la bahía.

desc.en: A small rocky islet off the Vung Tau coast, known to the French as Ile Archinard, with a temple and scenic views.
desc.es: Pequeño islote rocoso frente a la costa de Vung Tau, conocido por los franceses como Ile Archinard, con un templo y vistas panorámicas.

image.author: Alexis Lê-Quôc from New York, United States

desc.en: A leisure park on Núi Lớn reached by the Hồ Mây cable car, whose 8-person cabins take about 10 minutes.
desc.es: Parque de ocio en el Núi Lớn al que se llega en el teleférico Hồ Mây, cuyas cabinas de 8 personas tardan unos 10 minutos.

desc.en: A large Buddhist complex on the slope of Núi Nhỏ built 1969-1974 facing the sea, ranked a national historic site in 1989.
desc.es: Gran complejo budista en la ladera del Núi Nhỏ, construido entre 1969 y 1974 frente al mar y declarado sitio histórico nacional en 1989.

desc.en: A Theravada Buddhist temple on the northwest slope of Núi Lớn, built between 1961 and 1963 on about five hectares.
desc.es: Templo budista theravada en la ladera noroeste del Núi Lớn, construido entre 1961 y 1963 en unas cinco hectáreas.

desc.en: A coastal temple complex in Long Hải that began as a small shrine in the late 18th century and is a recognised national historic-cultural site.
desc.es: Complejo de templos costero en Long Hải que comenzó como un pequeño santuario a finales del siglo XVIII y es sitio histórico-cultural nacional.

desc.en: A sandy beach in Long Hải commune, east of Vung Tau, close to the Dinh Cô temple.
desc.es: Playa de arena en la comuna de Long Hải, al este de Vung Tau, cerca del templo Dinh Cô.

places.name: Ba Ria Cathedral

desc.en: The cathedral of the Bà Rịa Diocese at 227 Cách Mạng Tháng Tám, dedicated to Saints James and Philip, begun in 1874 and blessed in 1879.
desc.es: Catedral de la diócesis de Bà Rịa en el 227 Cách Mạng Tháng Tám, dedicada a los santos Santiago y Felipe, iniciada en 1874 y bendecida en 1879.

places.nameLocal: Nhà thờ Chánh tòa Bà Rịa

desc.en: A nationally recognised heritage complex, originally the communal house of Thắng Tam village, begun in 1820 at 77A Hoàng Hoa Thám.
desc.es: Complejo patrimonial reconocido a nivel nacional, antigua casa comunal de la aldea de Thắng Tam, iniciada en 1820 en 77A Hoàng Hoa Thám.

desc.en: The provincial museum on Thành Thái street, in the same area of Núi Lớn as the Bạch Dinh villa.
desc.es: El museo provincial en la calle Thành Thái, en la misma zona del Núi Lớn que la villa Bạch Dinh.

desc.en: A headland at the southernmost tip of Vung Tau, between Bãi Dứa and Bãi Sau; its name means 'welcoming the wind'.
desc.es: Cabo en el extremo sur de Vung Tau, entre Bãi Dứa y Bãi Sau; su nombre significa 'recibir el viento'.

places.name: Nui Nho Ancient Cannon Battery

desc.en: A historic cannon battery on Núi Nhỏ along Hải Đăng street, with start date 1862 recorded in OpenStreetMap.
desc.es: Antigua batería de cañones en el Núi Nhỏ, en la calle Hải Đăng, con fecha de inicio 1862 registrada en OpenStreetMap.

places.nameLocal: Trận địa pháo cổ Núi Nhỏ
